item.title: Match Preview: Maidstone United (A)
item.description: After beating Dorking Wanderers at home, the Daggers face an away trip to Maidstone United on Tuesday evening in the National League South. Here’s a look at the opposition. The post Match Preview: Maidstone United (A) appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Club Statement
item.description: Saturday’s match against Dorking Wanderers was a special day for everyone connected with Dagenham & Redbridge Football Club. However, the club has been made aware of two reported incidents during the match where discriminatory language was directed towards the match officials, tainting an otherwise unforgettable day. The post Club Statement appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
